name: snir-2015-proto-weeds.pdf
description: Snir et al. (2015) PLoS ONE study of the 23,000-year-old Ohalo II hunter-gatherer camp on the Sea of Galilee, documenting ~150,000 plant remains, 13 proto-weed species mixed with wild cereal seeds, and early trial cultivation predating agriculture by about 11,000 years.
